name: How long does a kitchen layout update typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen layout update typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen layout update varies significantly based on its complexity. A minor reconfiguration without extensive plumbing or electrical changes might take 3-6 weeks. A more comprehensive update involving significant structural changes, appliance relocation, and new custom cabinetry could extend to 8-12 weeks or more. Factors like material lead times, inspection schedules, and the contractor's availability also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen layout update typically takes 3-12 weeks, depending on complexity, from minor reconfigurations to complete overhauls. Material lead times and inspections also impact the schedule.
